plugins.name: Audio devices
plugins.description: Mute the microphone, change the volume, switch speakers and headsets, and set the volume of one app. Works on Windows, macOS and Linux.
plugins.author: PerritoDeck contributors

plugins.name: Clipboard snippets
plugins.description: Paste a saved piece of text with one press, and keep numbered slots you can save the clipboard into and paste back later.
plugins.author: PerritoDeck contributors
actions: Save the clipboard to a slot
values: What's in a slot (first 20 characters) (per slot number)

plugins.name: Clocks
plugins.description: The time and date here or anywhere in the world, countdowns, days until a date and the week number.
plugins.author: PerritoDeck contributors
values: Time (here, or in a time zone) (per time zone, e.g. asia/tokyo or utc+5:30)
Date (here, or in a time zone) (per time zone, e.g. america/new_york)
Week number (per time zone, e.g. europe/berlin)
Countdown to a date and time (e.g. 12d 4h) (per date and time, e.g. 2026-12-24t18:00)
Days until a date (per date, e.g. 2026-12-24, or 12-24 for every year)

plugins.name: Counters
plugins.description: Count things with a key press: deaths on stream, laps, cups of coffee. Counts are kept, and can be written to a text file for OBS.
plugins.author: PerritoDeck contributors

plugins.name: GitLab
plugins.description: Run, retry and watch GitLab CI/CD pipelines; count open merge requests and issues. Works with gitlab.com and your own GitLab.
plugins.author: PerritoDeck contributors
plugins.tested: Tested against a stand-in for the GitLab API, not yet with a real GitLab.

plugins.name: HTTP requests
plugins.description: Call a web address when a key is pressed or a slider moves: webhooks, REST APIs, smart plugs.
plugins.author: PerritoDeck contributors
plugins.tested: Tested against a test server on the same computer, not yet with real web services.

plugins.name: Philips Hue
plugins.description: Turn Hue lights and rooms on and off, dim them, change their colour and start scenes, through the Hue Bridge on your network.
plugins.author: PerritoDeck contributors
actions: Turn a light or room on or off
values: On or off (per light or room)
plugins.tested: Tested against a stand-in for a Hue Bridge, not yet with real Hue lights.

plugins.name: Elgato Key Light
plugins.description: Turn lights for Elgato Key Light, Key Light Air and Ring Light on and off, and set their brightness and shade of white, over your network.
plugins.author: PerritoDeck contributors
actions: Turn a light on or off
plugins.tested: Tested against stand-in lights, not yet with a real Key Light or Light Strip.

plugins.name: Now playing
plugins.description: Show what's playing (Spotify, Music, a browser or another media player) and play, pause or skip it. Works on Windows, macOS and Linux. On Linux it needs playerctl.
plugins.author: PerritoDeck contributors

plugins.name: MQTT
plugins.description: Publish an MQTT message when a key is pressed or a slider moves (Mosquitto, Zigbee2MQTT, Tasmota, Home Assistant).
plugins.author: PerritoDeck contributors
plugins.tested: Tested against a stand-in MQTT broker, not yet with a real one such as Mosquitto.

plugins.name: OBS Studio
plugins.description: Control OBS Studio 28 or newer: scenes, streaming, recording, audio, sources, filters, screenshots and more, with live status on your keys.
plugins.author: PerritoDeck contributors
actions: Split the recording into a new file
Add a chapter marker to the recording
Turn a source's volume up or down
Turn a filter on or off
Change the text of a text source
Send a caption on the stream
Send any request with the slider's value (advanced)
values: Last answer to Send any request
Scene is in the preview (on/off) (per scene)
Text of a text source (per text source)

plugins.name: Ollama
plugins.description: Load, unload and pull local AI models in Ollama, and ask one a question from a key.
plugins.author: PerritoDeck contributors
plugins.tested: Tested against a stand-in for Ollama, not yet with a real Ollama.

plugins.name: Proxmox VE
plugins.description: Start, shut down and watch Proxmox virtual machines and containers.
plugins.author: PerritoDeck contributors
values: Guest status (running, stopped, paused) (per vm or container id)
Guest is running (on/off) (per vm or container id)
Guest CPU use (%) (per vm or container id)
Guest memory use (%) (per vm or container id)
Guest uptime (per vm or container id)
Guest name (per vm or container id)
plugins.tested: Tested against a stand-in for the Proxmox VE API, not yet with a real server.

plugins.name: Screenshot
plugins.description: Take a screenshot of the whole screen, an area you pick or the window in front, save it with the date and time in its name, and copy it to the clipboard if you like.
plugins.author: PerritoDeck contributors

plugins.name: Soundboard
plugins.description: Play sound files (WAV, MP3 and more) from a key, and stop them again. Uses the players your computer already has.
plugins.author: PerritoDeck contributors

plugins.name: Spotify
plugins.description: Play, pause, skip, like and change the volume in Spotify on any of your devices, and show what's playing. Uses your Spotify account; controlling playback needs Spotify Premium.
plugins.author: PerritoDeck contributors
actions: Play a playlist, album or track
Add the current track to a playlist
plugins.tested: Tested against a stand-in for Spotify, not yet with the real Spotify service.

plugins.name: System monitor
plugins.description: Shows CPU, memory, disk, network, GPU, temperatures, uptime and battery on keys and sliders, updated every 2 seconds.
plugins.author: PerritoDeck contributors

plugins.name: Timers
plugins.description: Countdown timers, stopwatches and a Pomodoro timer on your keys. They keep going if the app restarts.
plugins.author: PerritoDeck contributors
actions: Skip to the next Pomodoro part
values: Timer or stopwatch is running (on/off) (per timer name)
How far the timer is, 0 to 100 (per timer name)
Pomodoro: how far this part is, 0 to 100

plugins.name: TrueNAS
plugins.description: Watch TrueNAS pools, alerts and apps, start and stop apps, and run scrubs and backup tasks.
plugins.author: PerritoDeck contributors
plugins.tested: Tested against a stand-in for the TrueNAS API, not yet with a real TrueNAS.

plugins.name: Twitch
plugins.description: Run your Twitch stream: markers, ads, clips, chat, title and category, moderation, raids, channel points, polls and predictions; show live status, viewers, followers, subs, the latest events and more.
plugins.author: PerritoDeck contributors
actions: Set the stream title or category
Ban or time out a user
values: Time live (per channel name, or me)
Stream title (per channel name, or me)
Subscribers (your channel) (per channel name, or me)
People in chat (where you moderate) (per channel name, or me)
Chat mode is on (on/off) (per emote, followers, slow, subscribers, unique or delay)
Time to the next ad (per channel name, or me)
Ad snoozes left (per channel name, or me)
Pre-roll free time left (per channel name, or me)
Ad playing (on/off) (per channel name, or me)
Poll question (per channel name, or me)
Poll: leading choice (per channel name, or me)
Poll: time left (per channel name, or me)
Prediction question (per channel name, or me)
Prediction: leading outcome (per channel name, or me)
Prediction: time left (per channel name, or me)
Latest follower (per channel name, or me)
Latest subscriber (per channel name, or me)
Latest gifted subs (per channel name, or me)
Latest cheer (per channel name, or me)
Latest raid (per channel name, or me)
Latest channel points redemption (per channel name, or me)
Hype train (per channel name, or me)
Follows since PerritoDeck started (per channel name, or me)
Subs since PerritoDeck started (per channel name, or me)
Time of the last clip made from the deck
plugins.tested: Tested against stand-ins for Twitch's sign-in, API and live events, not yet with real Twitch.

plugins.name: Is it up?
plugins.description: Shows whether your servers and web services answer: a web address, a host and port, or just a host name.
plugins.author: PerritoDeck contributors
values: Is up (on/off) (per web address, host:port or host)
Response time (per web address, host:port or host)
Status (up, down or the web answer code) (per web address, host:port or host)
plugins.tested: Tested against test servers on the same computer, not yet with real websites and hosts.

plugins.name: Weather
plugins.description: Current weather and today's forecast for any place, from Open-Meteo. Free, no account needed.
plugins.author: PerritoDeck contributors
values: Conditions (e.g. Light rain) (per place or latitude,longitude)
Chance of rain today (per place or latitude,longitude)
plugins.tested: Tested against a stand-in for Open-Meteo, not yet with the live service.

plugins.name: Windows and apps
plugins.description: Switch to an app (or open it), minimize, maximize, close or quit it, show the desktop, and show which app is in front. Windows, macOS and Linux (X11, Sway, Hyprland).
plugins.author: PerritoDeck contributors
actions: Minimize, maximize or close a window
values: Is the app running (on/off) (per app name)

plugins.name: Wake-on-LAN
plugins.description: Switch on a computer or server on your network with a key press. Wake-on-LAN must be turned on in its BIOS or network settings.
plugins.author: PerritoDeck contributors
plugins.tested: Tested by catching the wake-up packet on the same computer, not yet by waking a real one.
